description: The file defines a client class for interacting with the Amazon SageMaker Metrics service within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for batch get and put metrics operations, both synchronous and asynchronous.

classes.name: SageMakerMetricsClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with the Amazon SageMaker Metrics service, extending the base AwsClient.

methods.name: batchGetMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of metrics data from SageMaker Metrics service.

methods.name: batchGetMetricsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a batch of metrics data from SageMaker Metrics service.

methods.name: batchPutMetrics
methods.description: Uploads a batch of metrics to the SageMaker Metrics service.

methods.name: batchPutMetricsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously uploads a batch of metrics to the SageMaker Metrics service.
